contract.denominator: JAMB names in the canonical inheritance artifact (not the 237 CCMAS programme curriculum rows).
contract.partial: A course-scoped partial CCMAS bridge; it must not inherit the full parent curriculum.
contract.no_ccmas: D_custom/external scope; it must not inherit an unscoped CCMAS curriculum.
contract.multi_discipline: A combined row with two or more named CCMAS disciplines; component-level combinations within one discipline remain combined but are not counted as multi-discipline.
contract.split: A CCMAS component referenced by two or more JAMB names. This is an overlapping fan-out review queue, not proof of a separate full curriculum for each name.
contract.states: Stored review_required and unavailable states are retained; no state is promoted by this report.
